items.exampleEn: Sorry I'm late. I was held up in traffic.
items.exampleZh: 抱歉我遲到了，我被塞車耽擱了。

items.exampleEn: A boy on a bike almost knocked me down.
items.exampleZh: 一個騎腳踏車的男孩差點把我撞倒。

items.exampleEn: The new road will lead to more traffic in our town.
items.exampleZh: 這條新路會讓我們鎮上的車變多。

items.exampleEn: You left an important word out of this sentence.
items.exampleZh: 你這個句子漏掉了一個重要的字。

items.exampleEn: The ending of the movie really let me down.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的結局真的讓我很失望。

items.exampleEn: Look out! The floor is wet.
Her grandfather passed away before she was born.
items.exampleZh: 她的爺爺在她出生前就過世了。

items.sentenceEn: The repairs on the bridge held us up for an hour.
items.sentenceZh: 橋上的修理工程讓我們耽擱了一個小時。

items.audioEn: When you fill in the form, please don't leave out your phone number.
items.audioZh: 你填表格的時候，請不要漏掉你的電話號碼。
items.questionZh: 說話的人提醒聽者什麼事？

items.sentenceEn: Our old neighbor passed away last year at the age of ninety.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的老鄰居去年過世，享年九十歲。

items.sentenceEn: Look out for cars when you cross the street.

items.stemEn: The city will ____ the old building and build a park.
items.stemZh: 市政府會拆除那棟舊大樓，蓋一座公園。

items.stemEn: One small mistake can ____ big problems.
items.stemZh: 一個小錯誤可能導致大問題。

items.passageEn: Amy planned a surprise party for her best friend, Lisa. She invited everyone in their class, but she left out one name: Tom, Lisa's cousin. On the day of the party, Amy was held up at school, so she arrived late. When she finally came in, she saw Tom at the door with a cake. "Lisa's mom told me about the party," he said with a smile. Amy felt bad. She didn't want to let down her friends. But Lisa just laughed and said, "This is the best party ever!"
items.passageZh: Amy 替她最好的朋友 Lisa 辦了一場驚喜派對。她邀請了班上所有人，卻漏掉了一個名字：Lisa 的表親 Tom。派對當天，Amy 在學校被耽擱，所以晚到了。她終於進門時，看到 Tom 拿著蛋糕站在門口。「Lisa 的媽媽跟我說了派對的事。」他笑著說。Amy 覺得很過意不去，她不想讓朋友們失望。但 Lisa 只是笑著說：「這是有史以來最棒的派對！」

questions.questionZh: 派對當天 Amy 怎麼了？
options: 走錯地方，找不到派對地點

referenceEn: I will not let you down.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 let you down 等（代名詞受詞放中間）；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 disappoint you 等）也算對
表示承諾用表示未來的寫法（例如 won't、will not 等）

items.promptZh: 那隻狗把我弟弟撞倒了。
referenceEn: The dog knocked down my brother.
The dog knocked my brother down.
That dog knocked my little brother down.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 knocked down 等，受詞可放中間或後面；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 knocked over 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 knocked、has knocked 等）
「弟弟」可寫，例如 brother、little brother、younger brother 等
